parameters.content:
## Weekly Content Planner

Every Thursday this plans the week starting the coming Sunday: five services from a 19-week rotation, one per working day, each on LinkedIn, WhatsApp Channel, X and Instagram, with TikTok / Facebook / Snapchat rotating so the heavy formats do not fall due daily. Thursday also gets a Telegram digest of the five.

26 rows a week. All of them land on Ready for Review — this workflow schedules and drafts, it never publishes. No social account is connected yet, so publishing is a human action either way.

The copy, prices and tracked links come from businesspartner.sa/data/marketing-content.json, generated by docs/marketing-agent/generator/feed.mjs. Marketing claims live in the repo where a diff shows them, not in a Code node.
